summary: Tammy Irons was an elected House member and Florence attorney with local civic ties who won the open-seat Senate District 1 contest in Alabama's 2010 election. She had previously won a special election for that district in 2006, establishing her political network before seeking the Senate seat. Her pre-election Shor-McCarty score of -0.437 placed her around the middle of Alabama Democrats serving at that time.
